interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The selected VA de-minimis trigger applies to a fund manager within paragraph 28 if either the fund's stated objective is to invest in qualifying virtual assets or its intended qualifying VA investment is at least 1000 basis points of GAV. Tokenised Securities do not count toward either VA condition. A false result means only that this selected trigger does not apply. Exact-ratio representation under a validated positive denominator.

facts.description: Positive denominator of intended qualifying VA basis points; validated by exact-ratio adapter.
